GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions, answered.

Can I trade or transfer a contract today?

Trading, wallet custody, and on-chain contract issuance are in development. Marketplace figures are demonstration data. Buying service access does not currently mint a token or provide a tradable asset.

What am I paying for?

Plan 1 proposes investment-linked subscription tokens ($300–$10,000). Plan 2 combines tradable prepaid API rights with Plan 1 benefits ($5,000–$50,000). A service-only prepaid subscription derives value from services, not a promised financial return. Both displayed plans include proposed investment rights, which may be regulated. Final rights, API quantities, duration, eligibility, resale, and redemption terms are not yet established. No tokens or rights are issued by this preview.

How are my details stored?

Account records are encrypted in local files. Passwords are stored as salted hashes. Card details are handled by Razorpay and are not stored by this portal.

How do Google, Facebook and LinkedIn sign-in work?

Each provider uses its OAuth sign-in flow. Your first successful provider sign-in creates an account; later sign-ins return to that account. Accounts with the same email are not automatically linked. Use the original sign-in method for an existing account.

When will my access become active?

A confirmed payment appears in My Holdings. Service activation is pending confirmation by the Delta Lateral Indices team. Contact hello@delta-indices.info with your payment ID for support.
